properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 13 at 6:28PM MDT until August 13 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
SVRBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
East Central Elbert County in east central Colorado...
North Central Lincoln County in east central Colorado...
Southwestern Washington County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 700 PM MDT.

* At 628 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 6 miles north of
Limon, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Genoa and Cedar Point.
properties.areaDesc: Elbert, CO; Lincoln, CO; Washington, CO

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 13 at 5:35PM MDT until August 13 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 535 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
0.5 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up
to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches, roads,
and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Southwestern Aurora, eastern Centennial, Greenwood Village,
Foxfield and Cherry Creek Reservoir.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 13 at 5:33PM MDT until August 13 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:

shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, gulches, roads,
and poor drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
South Platte, Buffalo Creek and Foxton.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Last Resort Creek, Buffalo Creek, North Fork South Platte River,
Willow Creek, Bear Creek, Pine Creek, Spring Creek, West Bear
Creek, Indian Creek, South Platte River, Long Gulch and Shinglemill
Creek.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 13 at 5:11PM MDT until August 13 at 7:00PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...West Central Jefferson County in central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry creeks.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 511 PM MDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges
indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This may cause small
stream flooding. Overflowing poor drainage areas may cause minor
flooding in the advisory area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Last Resort Creek, Buffalo Creek, North Fork South Platte River,
Spring Creek, Long Gulch, Elk Creek and Shinglemill Creek.
Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Buffalo Creek and Foxton.
